name: Mega Merger
hook: Weld a Falcon Heavy directly onto a Cybertruck to bypass regulatory audit
tagline: Duct tape electric pickups to interplanetary boosters as the corporate valuation surges toward infinity. Cashing out signs the golden parachute and parachutes safely into a private lagoon. Crashing sparks a catastrophic SEC audit that snaps the merger in half with a galactic pop.
